name: Mars Rover
author: ahnmur
description:
Haven't you always wanted to be a NASA rover op? Well today is your day. The controls are all yours. 

How to: 
⬆️ Keyboard up arrow for acceleration
⬇️ Keyboard back arrow braking and reverse
⬅️ Keyboard left/right arrows for turning
☠️ If you fall off the path, you just re-spawn at the start!

Special thanks: 
🙏 NASA for the cover image
🙏 To clgreene86 on Sketchfab for the Rover model 
🙏 To The Whole Other for the music: "Ether Oar"
🙏 Unity's Create With Code course (Unit 1 - Player Control).
